summary: Phase 3 back-office end-to-end tested. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_phase3.py — delivery/invoice auto-generation (INV-YYYY-####, unpaid default, PAID/UNPAID toggle, DELETE), POD photo + signature file_id persistence, maintenance overdue/OK status flow (last_done 90000 + interval 5000 vs current_odo 100000 -> OVERDUE, Mark Serviced resets to current odo + today -> OK), trip stop bumps rig.current_odometer, expenses (Fuel gallons+state, Toll) with IFTA aggregation (TX row combining completed-trip mileage + fuel gallons), /api/office/summary shape, and driver 403 on all 8 back-office endpoints (GET/POST for deliveries/maintenance/expenses + GET ifta-report/office/summary). Frontend (390x844 mobile, owner=owner/1910, driver=driver/1234): Owner sees Home/Rigs/Trip/Office/Docs nav; /office hub renders 3 cards (office-deliveries/maintenance/expenses) with summary counts from /api/office/summary. Deliveries: New Delivery form filled (customer, rig=Big Blue, rate=1350), drew a stroke on the signature canvas via mouse.down->move->up over delivery-signature-pad, Save & Create Invoice uploaded the PNG signature and created delivery -> card 0 shows 'INV-YYYY-####' + '$1,350' + 'UNPAID'; opening card 0 renders invoice-view with INV number, Amount Due $1,350, invoice-signature whose natural size is 600x220 (proves signature PNG round-tripped through /api/upload -> /api/files/{id}). invoice-toggle-paid flips to PAID and back to UNPAID; invoice-delete cleans up. Maintenance: edit-odometer- opens dialog, saved 100,000 mi via odometer-input + save-odometer-button; add-maintenance-button dialog: picked Big Blue, Oil Change, interval 5000, last_done 90,000 -> maintenance-status-0 badge = OVERDUE; maintenance-service-0 (Mark Serviced) resets it -> badge = OK. Expenses: Fuel expense (amount 285.40, gallons 62, TX) and Toll (12.50) created, running total and per-category chips render, expense-delete- removes. tab-ifta shows Total Miles 360 / Gallons 124 / Fleet MPG 2.9 with ifta-row-TX '360 mi, 124 gal, $533.4'. Role enforcement: driver login shows only Home/Trip/Tools/Docs (no nav-office); direct navigation to /office /deliveries /maintenance /expenses all redirect the driver back to '/' (ownerOnly guard). Phase 1 & Phase 2 regression suites (16/16 + 11/11) unchanged and still passing.

issues: Radix Dialog triggers benign 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' errors that CRA's dev overlay surfaces full-screen and blocks pointer events. Purely cosmetic/dev-only (does not affect production build) — but disrupts anyone screen-sharing the preview. Consider adding the standard ResizeObserver-error swallow shim in index.js: window.addEventListener('error', e => { if (e.message.includes('ResizeObserver')) e.stopImmediatePropagation(); }).

action_items: Optional: swallow the benign ResizeObserver dev-overlay so it stops blocking the preview during demos.
Optional: /api/office/summary + /api/maintenance recompute maint status per request — for many rigs this is fine, but consider caching or a Mongo aggregation if the fleet grows.

Nice-to-have: /api/deliveries invoice_number uses count_documents() to build the next serial. If a delivery is deleted, the next one will reuse that number (INV-YYYY-#### is not unique across time). Fine for MVP; use a monotonically-increasing counter (e.g. findAndModify on a counters doc) if uniqueness matters.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:790 invoice_number = f"INV-{now.year}-{count+1:04d}" — this is derived from count_documents(). Deleting a delivery then creating a new one will collide with an older invoice number. Use an atomic counter in db.counters for true uniqueness.
server.py:783/824/886 Phase 3 endpoints correctly use require_owner (verified via pytest — driver gets 403 on all 8 routes).
server.py:681-684 stop_trip() correctly bumps rig.current_odometer only when new end_odometer > existing — good.
compute_maint() elevates status by max severity across miles + days rules — correct precedence.
Deliveries.js save() awaits sigRef.current.toBlob() then posts to /api/upload with FormData — verified working; signature natural 600x220 confirms the canvas PNG survived the round-trip.
Frontend still uses window.confirm for delete confirmations across Deliveries/Maintenance/Expenses — inconsistent with the app's shadcn Dialog usage everywhere else.
Expenses.js sort uses date desc; multiple entries with the same date have non-deterministic order (bit me in testing when asserting expense-card-0). Consider secondary sort by created_at.
server.py:1013 still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'); FastAPI recommends lifespan handlers.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of Phase 3 critical flows (deliveries+signature+invoice, maintenance overdue/OK, expenses+IFTA, driver role gate)

seed_data_creation: Test data created during runs was cleaned up (deliveries, maintenance items, expenses). Baseline sample rig 'Big Blue' + 5 sample documents unchanged. Left leftover Phase-1 'UI TEST Rig' still in DB (noted in iteration_2).

Covers deliveries+invoices, maintenance status/service/odometer, trip-stop odometer bump, expenses+IFTA, office summary, and driver 403 on all 8 back-office endpoints. Frontend flows verified: signature drawing on delivery-signature-pad works via mouse events (canvas PNG round-trips via /api/upload -> /api/files/{id}, natural size 600x220 in the invoice view). rca of the issue: No blocking issues. One code-quality note worth surfacing: invoice_number is derived from count_documents at creation time, so INV-YYYY-#### is not guaranteed unique across delete+create cycles — recommend switching to an atomic counter for durable uniqueness.
